description: Convert the user's Markdown source to text ready to paste into WhatsApp. Before calling, copy the supplied source unchanged into text: do not Markdown-escape it or pre-convert it. Example: source **Meeting tomorrow** must be passed as **Meeting tomorrow**; the tool returns *Meeting tomorrow*. Preserve backslashes the user actually supplied, but never insert extra ones. After calling, display structuredContent.formattedText verbatim in a plain-text fenced code block, without escaping or reformatting it. Supports # headings, bold, italics, strikethrough, lists and links. Preserves URL destinations, literal text and fenced/inline code. Unsupported blocks remain literal; does not render HTML, summarize or translate. Inputs are processed by this server to return the result; this tool does not store or log phone numbers or text. It does not access an account or send messages.

text.description: The user's original Markdown source, up to 12,000 UTF-16 code units. Copy it unchanged: do not render it, pre-convert formatting, or add backslashes before Markdown punctuation. For **Meeting tomorrow**, pass exactly **Meeting tomorrow** as the decoded text value. Preserve backslashes only when present in the user's source; normal JSON string encoding must not change the decoded text.

name: format_whatsapp_text

formattedText.description: Finished WhatsApp text, ready to copy. Display this value verbatim in a plain-text fenced code block; do not add backslash escapes, change emphasis markers, or format it again. Choose a fence that does not conflict with code already in the returned text.

title: Format text for WhatsApp
